WITH task_ctx AS (
    SELECT t.id AS task_id, trp.object_id AS package_id, ttd.object_id AS deployment_id
    FROM tasks t
    JOIN task_retires_package trp ON trp.subject_id = t.id
    JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.subject_id = t.id
    WHERE t.id = 'task:fx06-cutover'

    JOIN task_ctx tc ON mdp.object_id = tc.package_id

    FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
    JOIN legacy_modules lm ON mdm.object_id = lm.module_id
),
affected_services AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
    FROM service_implements_module sim
    JOIN legacy_modules lm ON sim.object_id = lm.module_id
